mapper.sql: select r.return_id,r.assignment_id,r.student_id,su.nick_name student_name,r.workstation_id,room.room_name, w.workstation_no,w.workstation_type,r.source_type,r.status,r.reason,r.mentor_comment,r.admin_comment, r.photo_urls,r.photo_upload_time,r.student_cleared,r.create_time from gw_return_application r join gw_workstation w on w.workstation_id=r.workstation_id left join gw_room room on room.room_id=w.room_id left join sys_user su on su.user_id=r.student_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from gw_return_application where assignment_id=#{assignmentId} and status in ('PENDING_MENTOR','PENDING_ADMIN','WAIT_CLEAR','WAIT_VERIFY')
mapper.update: update gw_return_application set status=#{toStatus}, mentor_comment=if(#{mentorId} is not null,#{comment},mentor_comment), admin_comment=if(#{mentorId} is null,#{comment},admin_comment), student_cleared=if(#{toStatus}='WAIT_CLEAR',0,student_cleared),update_time=now() where return_id=#{returnId} and status=#{fromStatus} and exists(select 1 from gw_user_profile p where p.user_id=gw_return_application.student_id and p.mentor_id=#{mentorId})
update gw_return_application set status='COMPLETED',admin_comment=#{comment},operator_id=#{operatorId}, verified_time=now(),update_time=now() where return_id=#{returnId} and status='PENDING_ADMIN'

update gw_return_application set photo_urls=#{photoUrls},photo_upload_time=now(),student_cleared=1, status=#{toStatus},update_time=now() where return_id=#{returnId} and student_id=#{studentId} and status='WAIT_CLEAR'
update gw_return_application set student_cleared=1,status='WAIT_VERIFY',cleared_time=now(),update_time=now() where return_id=#{returnId} and status='WAIT_CLEAR' and source_type is null

update gw_return_application set status='WAIT_CLEAR',student_cleared=0,admin_comment=#{comment},operator_id=#{operatorId},cleared_time=null,update_time=now() where return_id=#{returnId} and status='WAIT_VERIFY' and source_type is null

update gw_return_application set status='COMPLETED',admin_comment=#{comment},operator_id=#{operatorId},verified_time=now(),update_time=now() where return_id=#{returnId} and status='WAIT_VERIFY' and source_type is null
